title: US imposes sanctions on ICC hours after former judge wins Nobel Peace Prize
summary: The US has imposed sanctions on the International Criminal Court (ICC) just hours after a former ICC judge was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize, highlighting escalating tensions between the US government and the international tribunal.
